description:
Configure safety settings for the 'Production-Deploy' job to prevent race conditions. The job currently allows concurrent builds and triggers immediately, which causes issues. 

Required changes:
1. Disable concurrent builds (ensure 'Execute concurrent builds if necessary' is unchecked).
2. Set a Quiet Period of exactly 120 seconds.
3. Enable 'Block build when upstream project is building' (the upstream project is 'Backend-Build').
